operations.summary: Rename, merge or delete a tag, person or organization by name
operations.description: Called by the peer with its credential, never by the screens; any other caller gets 404. Applies the change by canonical name in one transaction. A missing `name` changes nothing and returns `changed: false`; a merge skips the absent `sources`, returning them in `skipped`, and creates `into` only when a source exists. A person or organization name held by several entries names the lowest id. A `newName` another entry holds returns 409 conflict with tag_name_taken (with `tagName`), person_name_taken or organization_name_taken; a `newName` or `into` that breaks the name rule returns 400 invalid_request with the tag name or work-info reasons. operations.summary: Apply selected items of a person fetch
operations.description: Owner-only. Atomically writes the selected profile fields, replacing stored values, and appends the chosen aliases, external IDs and links the person lacks, up to 50, 20 and 100; after commit, the image at imageIndex replaces the person's face. Invalid values, entries over the limits and external IDs another person holds are skipped, and no people are merged. A successful result is consumed. For a person of the paired node, this node rechecks its plugin, the peer writes the values, and the image is uploaded to the peer as the face; an unreachable peer returns 503 service_unavailable and keeps the result. An empty selection, aliases, externalIds or profile.links in items, an item or value the result lacks, or image without an imageIndex among the kept images return 400 invalid_request. A person deleted or merged away returns 404 person_not_found. Expired, unknown or another person's results, or plugin replacement, revocation or deletion after the fetch, return 409 work_info_fetch_stale. These errors write nothing.

operations.summary: Write one code per selected video
operations.description: Owner-only. Replaces only the code of each item's user-data key, keeping the key's other work information, in one transaction. The code itself is last-write-wins. Errors write nothing and name the item in `field`: 400 invalid_request for no items, over 1,000 items, a repeated videoId (items[i].videoId) or a second item on a key an earlier item already writes (items[i].videoId); 400 work_info_empty, work_info_too_long or work_info_control_characters at items[i].code; 404 video_not_found at items[i].videoId for a missing, hidden or merged video; 409 content_changed at items[i].contentVersion when the video's contentVersion differs from the item's. A missing video is reported before a changed one. Emits the same events as setVideoWorkInfo for every video of each changed key and writes no activity. Uses `Cache-Control: no-store`. Items whose videoId is at or above 2^40 name the paired VVMDM's videos: the local items are applied first in one transaction, then the peer's in one forwarded request; applied counts both nodes and remote reports the peer's part, with the peer's video ids that were not changed when it failed.

operations.summary: Apply one bulk edit to selected videos
operations.description: Owner-only. Applies every present part to videoIds plus the current member videos of smartFolderIds, under the same 1–20,000 distinct-video limit as updateVideoTags, in one transaction; videos sharing a user-data key change together. tags.add attaches by ID or by name (resolving synonyms and creating a missing tag), tags.remove detaches manual attachments by ID; credits follows VideoCreditEdit; dates sets each listed kind, null clearing it; public sets visibility and ends guest streams of videos made private. Other values stay as they are. A request without any change returns 400 invalid_request. Errors write nothing: a missing tag returns 404 tag_not_found, a missing credit 404 person_not_found or organization_not_found, and an invalid value 400 with `field` at its location in the request, such as credits[0].ids[1] or dates[0].date. Emits the same events and activity as the single-part endpoints. Ids at or above 2^40 name the paired VVMDM's videos and smart folders: the request splits by node, applies the local part first in one transaction and then the peer's part in one forwarded request, and a smart folder of either node adds the other node's videos matching its rule. The limit counts both nodes' resolved videos together. Tags, people and organizations go to the other node by name, created there when missing; a provisional person, which has no name, with a target on the other node returns 400 invalid_request with provisional_person_remote at its field. applied counts both nodes and remote reports the peer's part, with the peer's video ids that were not changed when it failed.

Invalid values, excess entries and ambiguous people/organizations are skipped. A successful result is consumed. Invalid or rejected tag names are reported in skippedTags without assignment. Optional tags selects fetched names and limits skippedTags to that selection. people, organizations, urls and externalIds append the chosen entries and values, and the linked people's empty profile fields fill from theirs. An empty selection, a field without a value, a role, urls or externalIds in fields, a position or value the result lacks, empty/unknown tag selections, tags without fields containing tags, or cover without a coverIndex among covers return 400 invalid_request. Missing video or mismatched result video returns 404 not_found. Expired/unknown results or plugin replacement, revocation or deletion after fetch return 409 work_info_fetch_stale. operations.summary: Approve an assistant proposal for execution

No index, or an index the proposal does not have, returns 400 invalid_request. A missing, discarded or expired proposal returns 404 not_found; any other status returns 409 proposal_not_pending with the proposal in the error's proposal field; a kept step that uses what an unticked step creates returns 409 step_needs_skipped with that kept step's index in the error's step field.

operations.summary: Fetch a person's information with a person plugin
operations.description: Owner-only. Runs approved person plugin pluginId's fetch once and retains the result in memory for ten minutes without changing the person. source and id come together, from a search candidate; link fetches by that link and returns 400 person_link_unsupported before running when its host matches none of the plugin's domains. With neither, VV sends the person's first stored external ID, in (source, value) order, whose source the plugin declares; without one, the person's only link the plugin handles, after keeping once links that differ only in scheme, host case or a trailing slash; it returns 409 person_link_ambiguous with the choices in links when several remain, and 409 person_external_id_missing when there is no such ID or link, both before running. For a person of the paired node, this node's plugin runs and the peer gives the person's IDs and links; the result's images and apply are answered here too. Missing person returns 404 person_not_found; missing plugin 404 not_found; a work-info plugin 409 plugin_kind_mismatch; only one of source and id, an undeclared source, an id outside 1–200 characters after trimming, a link that is not an http or https URL, link with source or id, or a link the plugin no longer handles when it runs 400 invalid_request. See Run failures in docs/design-docs/work-info-plugins.md.

operations.summary: Fetch video work information with a plugin
operations.description: Owner-only. Runs approved pluginId fetch once with a trimmed 1–200 character id from search or owner input, or with a link. Even URL-shaped IDs are passed unchanged; VV does not fetch them as URLs. A link must be an http or https URL (else 400 invalid_request) that one of the plugin's domains matches (else 400 work_info_link_unsupported), checked before the plugin runs; both or neither of id and link is 400 invalid_request. Retains the result in memory for ten minutes and returns 201 without changing the video. Missing/invalid id returns 400 invalid_request. Includes title only if it passes display-name rules. People and organizations carry their fetch-time match. Missing video returns 404 not_found; a person plugin returns 409 plugin_kind_mismatch; undeclared fetch returns 409 operation_unsupported. See Run failures in docs/design-docs/work-info-plugins.md.

Pairing is one-directional: link is the VVMDM this node reads, and grant the VVMDM that reads this one; each is absent until paired in that direction, and they are independent, so a mutual pairing is two pairings. Owners receive the link's name, address and version, the grant's name and pairing time, and this node's identity; guests receive state and reason only. state is the link's connection, held in memory: after a start it is unpaired without a link, revoked when the read node refused the link's secret, and unreachable with reason network otherwise, until a connection succeeds. One open event stream to the read node is the liveness signal: connected while it is open, unreachable when it fails, retried after 5 s doubling to 60 s. Each reconnection compares the read node's node id (reason network when it differs); versions are never compared, and the read node's version is shown for reference only; a pinned certificate that changed stops it with reason certificate and the new fingerprint; 401 peer_unknown from the read node marks the link revoked and gives revoked.

For grouped videos, the contextual group supplies playback order and a window of up to 100 members centered on this video. Read members outside that window with `listVideoGroupMembers`. On a paired node the list holds the visible videos of both nodes, a remote id also opens one, and the directory clue is 0 between nodes; while the peer cannot be reached its videos are left out.

scope selects direct locations (default, excluding descendants) or the entire subtree. Query matching considers only locations in that scope; pagination, filtering (including tag, person, personRole, organization and tagKind) and sorting follow listVideos. title and sizeBytes use the lexicographically first matching location path in scope, deduplicating videos with multiple locations. Missing folders return 404 regardless of scope/query. Version bundles appear only when their effective representative has a location in scope; other versions never appear individually. Bundle queries may match any version location, but title and sizeBytes use the first representative location in scope. Guests see public videos only; folders with no public-video locations, including roots, return 404. Guest watch filters other than all, played/favorited sorts, favorite=true, tag, person, organization and tagKind return 400 invalid_request.

organization.description: Organization ID, matching any role; follows person filter semantics

organizationName.description: Canonical organization name; follows `organization` semantics, and a name no organization has matches no video.

personName.description: Canonical person name; follows `person` semantics for every person with that name, and `personRole` applies to it as to `person`. A name no person has matches no video.

query.description: Search terms are ANDed. Double quotes form phrases, a leading `-` excludes a term, and standalone `OR` or `|` joins alternatives. Matching normalizes width, case and hiragana/katakana, and checks title and relative paths below registered folders by substring. Uses at most 16 terms; no remaining terms means no filter. Syntax errors are not reported.

scope.description: direct selects immediate locations; subtree includes all descendants

operations.summary: Read the node whose code the owner typed
operations.description: Sends the code and this node's identity to the other node's acceptPairing and stores the link with the secret it answers; the other node stores a grant and never connects to this one, so this node needs no address of its own and no inbound reachability. An address without http or https scheme or host, or with a path, query or user, returns 400 invalid_request with invalid_address and field. A refused code returns 400 invalid_code; a node that already reads one, or whose target another node already reads, 409 already_paired; a failed call 409 peer_unreachable; an HTTPS certificate the system roots do not verify 409 certificate_untrusted with fingerprint. Sending fingerprint again accepts a certificate with that SPKI and pins it.

address.description: The other node's base URL, http or https, without a path

code.description: The code the other node's Pairing page shows

fingerprint.description: The SPKI fingerprint the owner confirmed after certificate_untrusted

operations.summary: Return this node's identity to the reading node

playbackId.description: Client playback identifier in RFC 4122 string form. Its first save adds one history entry; later saves with the same ID add none. Send only after playback starts; invalid format returns 400 invalid_request.

operations.summary: Score this node's videos against a video of the other node
operations.description: Called by the peer with its credential, never by the screens; any other caller gets 404. Scores the visible videos of this node, except `exclude`, against `clues` with the related-video scorer and returns one page in the related order (score, then newer addedAt, then larger id) after `cursor`. The clues carry no directory: the same-directory clue counts only when `openVideoId` names this node's video that the caller's audience can see, and then from that video's representative directory, as this node's own related list does. An unknown or hidden `openVideoId` gives no folder points and no error. See docs/design-docs/related-videos.md.

clues.description: What the node holding a video sends so the other node can score its own videos against it; no directory.

frames.description: The encoded frame hashes, as stored

tags.description: Names of the video's confirmed, tentative and folder-name tags

words.description: The words the scorer takes from the title and the file name

cursor.description: Previous `nextCursor`; omit to start at the beginning

exclude.description: This node's video ids to leave out: the open video and its group members when held here

openVideoId.description: The open video, in this node's ids, when this node holds it; omit when the caller holds it. It adds the same-directory clue for this node's videos in its directory

videoIds.description: Two distinct video IDs to record as different videos.

operations.description: Owner-only. missing, the only scope, queues videos never analysed or whose analysis failed; an analysed video is analysed again only by a recognizer switch. Returns the queued count. Videos queued while the runtime is not ready wait for it. While off returns 409 face_recognition_off. See docs/design-docs/face-recognition.md.

Starts a manual scan in force mode over the library, one media folder or one video: every video in the scope is read again and its probe, thumbnail, seek thumbnail, preview and fingerprint are rebuilt even when the file is unchanged, and auto-tagging and face analysis run on it again while each feature is on. A running watch scan is superseded first. A running manual scan or force rescan returns 409 scan_in_progress, no media folder returns 409 media_folders_not_configured, a missing folder or video returns 404 not_found, and an unknown scope or a target that does not match it returns 400 invalid_request. Responds immediately while the rescan runs in the background.

operations.summary: Start thumbnail editing from a frame or the current thumbnail

For source=thumbnail, uses the original applied image (long edge at most 2048 px), otherwise the explicit thumbnail frame or the automatic job position, falling back to the first frame. Returns a ready session with 201; it retains its starting image. Cancels any prior ComfyUI run for this video before closing its session. Missing/out-of-range frame position returns 400 thumbnail_position_out_of_range; other position/location errors follow the thumbnail-position endpoint. Needs no ComfyUI configuration, so the page can read the starting image to frame it; runs return 409 thumbnail_edit_not_ready without one. Unavailable frame or saved image returns 409 thumbnail_frame_unavailable. A virtual video returns 409 virtual_video. Sessions are memory-only and emit no events.

Otherwise behaves like startThumbnailEdit: a ready session with 201 that replaces any prior session for the video. An oversized image returns 400 thumbnail_upload_too_large with limit; an unreadable one 400 thumbnail_upload_invalid. A virtual video returns 409 virtual_video. Runs need a ComfyUI configuration.

operations.summary: Stream import and video changes through Server-Sent Events

While paired, the peer's video, group and smartFolder events are forwarded with its ids plus 2^40. Sends one current scan on connection when available, but does not replay missed video/group/smartFolder/candidates/activity/onboarding/assistant events. assistant carries an empty object to owners after every committed change of an assistant proposal; refetch the proposals the panel shows. Guests receive only group, smartFolder and peer; scan, video, onboarding, candidates, activity and assistant are owner-only.
Supports Range requests with `206 Partial Content` and `Content-Range`; see [http-routes.md](./http-routes.md). Files are served unchanged even when `playable=false`.

operations.summary: List the code rows of selected videos
operations.description: Owner-only. Resolves videoIds plus the current member videos of smartFolderIds, as summarizeVideoEdits does, under a limit of 1–1,000 distinct videos counted before bundling; over it returns 400 too_many_videos with limit 1000. Returns one row per user-data key of the resolved videos in the library, in the order the videos were first listed. A row's video is the owner list item of the key's shown video (a bundle's representative) and code the key's current code, absent when there is none. Uses `Cache-Control: no-store`. Ids at or above 2^40 name the paired VVMDM's videos and smart folders: the request splits by node and reads each node's rows, and a smart folder of either node adds the other node's videos matching its rule. The limit counts both nodes' resolved videos together. This node's rows come first; when the peer does not answer, the rows cover this node's videos only.

Ids at or above 2^40 name the paired VVMDM's videos and smart folders: the request splits by node and reads each node's summary, and a smart folder of either node adds the other node's videos matching its rule. The limit counts both nodes' resolved videos together. Counts merge by the name of the tag, person or organization, a provisional person staying apart; when the peer does not answer, the summary covers this node's videos only.

smartFolderIds.description: Smart-folder IDs resolved at request time to their current member videos (the saved rule plus every ancestor rule, groups expanded to their videos) and added to videoIds. Missing folders are ignored.

videoIds.description: Video IDs to summarize. May be empty when smartFolderIds is not.

The limit counts both nodes' resolved videos together. Counts merge by tag name; when the peer does not answer, the summary covers this node's videos only.

operations.summary: Add or remove a video tag
operations.description: Applies action (add/remove) and tag to videoIds plus the current member videos of smartFolderIds, for single-video and bulk callers. Removal requires tag.id; name returns 400. Addition by name resolves synonyms and creates a missing tag. The union must hold 1–20,000 distinct videos after smart folders are resolved, or the request returns 400 too_many_videos without changes; all changes are atomic. Ids at or above 2^40 name the paired VVMDM's videos and smart folders: the request splits by node, applies the local part first in one transaction and then the peer's part in one forwarded request, and a smart folder of either node adds the other node's videos matching its rule. The limit counts both nodes' resolved videos together. Tags go to the peer by name, created there when missing; applied counts both nodes and remote reports the peer's part, with the peer's video ids that were not changed when it failed.

smartFolderIds.description: Smart-folder IDs resolved at request time to their current member videos (the saved rule plus every ancestor rule, groups expanded to their videos) and added to videoIds. Missing folders are ignored.

tag.description: Tag reference with exactly one of id or name; both or neither return 400 invalid_request.

videoIds.description: Video IDs to change. May be empty when smartFolderIds is not.

operations.summary: Set a person's face from an uploaded image
operations.description: Owner-only. Accepts multipart `image` (PNG, JPEG or static WebP) under the thumbnail upload's limits: 64 MiB with 1 MiB additional multipart overhead, and 120 million pixels. Fits it to at most 800 px on its long side, stores it as JPEG, replacing any earlier face, and returns Person with a new imageRevision. A body over the byte limit returns 413 person_image_too_large with limit. Unsupported, animated, unreadable or over-pixel images return 400 person_image_invalid. The image is stored whatever face recognition finds in it. Missing person returns 404 person_not_found. Errors write nothing. After the body arrives, fitting continues despite disconnect, with a five-minute limit.

operations.summary: Use an uploaded image as the video thumbnail
operations.description: Owner-only. Accepts multipart `image` (PNG, JPEG or static WebP), up to 64 MiB and 120 million pixels, with 1 MiB additional multipart overhead. Fully decodes in memory and fits the video aspect ratio, 16:9 for a virtual video, using the generated-image application path. Waits for publication, returning Video with thumbnailImage=uploaded and a new thumbnailUrl; preserves the saved frame position. Oversized data or dimensions return 400 thumbnail_upload_too_large with limit. Unsupported, animated or unreadable images return 400 thumbnail_upload_invalid. Missing video returns 404 video_not_found; deletion, changed content or stale contentVersion since request start returns 409 content_changed; failed fitting returns 409 thumbnail_image_invalid. Errors write nothing. After upload completes, validation/application continues despite disconnect, with a five-minute limit. Emits a video event after commit.

contentVersion.description: Video contentVersion held by the UI when the preview opened.

operations.summary: Add a work-info plugin or replace one with the same name
operations.description: Owner-only. Accepts one multipart module (WebAssembly up to 16 MiB), inspects without execution and saves its filename. A matching manifest name replaces the existing row with 200, whatever either kind; otherwise creates with 201. Replacement resets approval, takes kind, sources and domains from the new manifest and preserves values only for keys declared by the new manifest. A work-info plugin new to the link order is placed just before the bundled plugin, and a replacement keeps its place. A manifest named vv.link returns 409 plugin_builtin without writes. Unusable modules are saved with state=invalid and problem. Missing/multiple modules return 400 invalid_request; oversized modules return 413 plugin_too_large with limit, without writing.
